newsitem.title: USA: Home Centers Q1 revenues $25 million.
newsitem.headline: Home Centers Q1 revenues $25 million.

text.p: Home Centers Ltd said Thursday its first quarter revenues totalled $25 million, using the exchange rate of 3.36 Israeli shekels per U.S. dollar.
In shekels, first quarter revenues rose to 84 million shekels from 64 million a year earlier, it said.
The home improvement products supplier said first quarter revenues were up 31.2 percent from a year earlier.
The year-ago figure in U.S. dollars was not immediately available.
Same-store sales in the first quarter of 1996 were significantly higher due to the Passover holiday period, a major sales week, falling during the first quarter.
In 1997, Passover fell in April. As a result, same-store sales for the first two weeks of April were significantly ahead of the same period in 1996, it said.
